messages:
zoe: urgent kitten update: Kodi learned how to open the desk drawer and now considers it a personal bunker. pic: https://i.imgur.com/KodiBunker.jpg :cat_with_wry_smile:
rahul: drawer sovereignty is a valid career path. has he claimed any electronics yet? :eyes:
marie: he stole my headphone foam last week and replaced it with a receipt. his taste is eclectic.
zoe: audio: tiny meow when confronted. will upload. also he only responds to the song 'mystery box' (which is not a real song)
tony: proposal: laser diplomacy. if you can get him to stop using drawers as forts with a red dot, you win a cookie.
rahul: tried laser, he used it to herd a plastic bag instead. now we have a bag-herding specialist.
marie: poll: official title suggestions? reply with your pick in thread: Drawer Overlord / Chief Napping Officer / Minister of Snacks
zoe: votes: Chief Napping Officer
rahul: votes: Drawer Overlord
tony: votes: Minister of Snacks
ops-bot: reminder: please avoid leaving small ingestible items in drawers accessible to pets. See office pet policy. :information_source:
marie: remote-friendly plan: i'll set up a "Kodi cam" for the afternoon nap so remote folks can submit captions. everyone must vote for best caption.
zoe: current top caption: 'In case of emergency, pet the cat.' also added a tiny crown emoji to his tag.
rahul: will bring tuna-smell treats Friday for bribery. may need to sign a ceremonial waiver. :grin:
zoe: final pic: Kodi mid-pounce onto a pile of important-looking post-its. sorry finance. https://i.imgur.com/KodiPounce.jpg :sweat_smile:
